module: hsk-studio-reel src/prores (cargo feature prores, default off)

implementation_sources.document: SMPTE RDD 36:2022, Apple ProRes Bitstream Syntax and Decoding Process

implementation_sources.use: verified reading notes of RDD 36 (header byte offsets, clamp, alpha quirks), written by a researcher from RDD 36 only

third_party_codec_source_consulted: none: no ffmpeg (proresdec, prores_ks, proresenc), Craft prores crate, oxideav-prores or any other ProRes implementation was read
external_tools: ffmpeg 8.1.1 (gyan.dev build) used only as a black-box fixture generator and reference decoder; its output is test data
apple_statements_read: https://support.apple.com/en-us/118584 (Apple ProRes and ProRes RAW Authorized Products)
licence_status: not Apple-certified; shipping decision D24 (opt-in feature); Operator item D22 (licensing enquiry to Apple) open
studio_assumptions: output bit depth 10 for 4:2:2 frames and 12 for 4:4:4 frames (RDD 36 has no bit-depth field)
sample clamp [0, 2^b - 1] (7.5.1 default) and rounding ties up
encoded alpha refused (prores-alpha) until the decoded-frame model has an alpha plane
